products.name: Bitcoin Treasury and Investment Operations
products.description: Acquisition, holding, and management of Bitcoin as a treasury reserve asset, including options-writing strategies and minority investments in Bitcoin-native companies. This is a capital-intensive, regulated activity involving digital asset custody and trading through institutional-grade custodians and exchanges.

products.name: Bitcoin-Focused Asset Management Services
products.description: Management of investment funds focused on Bitcoin and Bitcoin-related equities, derivatives, and yield strategies, earning management and performance fees. Delivered through UTXO, this involves discretionary portfolio management and risk controls for external investors.

products.name: Bitcoin Media and Publishing
products.description: Operation of digital and print media brands, including Bitcoin Magazine and related properties, providing news, content, advertising, and marketing platforms focused on Bitcoin. Content is distributed globally via digital, print, and ecommerce channels.

products.name: Bitcoin Conferences and Events
products.description: Organization and production of large-scale Bitcoin-focused conferences and event series, including the flagship annual Bitcoin Conference and regional events, generating revenue from ticket sales and sponsorships. Events are produced in-house and through licensing/joint ventures.

products.name: Bitcoin Strategy Advisory Services
products.description: Provision of strategic advisory and consulting services to Bitcoin-native and adjacent businesses, including guidance on capital formation, transactions, regulatory complexity, and scaling. Delivered through the 'Bitcoin for Corporations' brand.

products.name: Patient Care and Medical Services (Healthcare Operations)
products.description: Provision of in-person and telemedicine healthcare services focused on value-based, patient-centered care, including pain management, behavioral therapy, addiction treatment, urgent care, preventative medicine, weight loss, and hormone therapy. Services are delivered by licensed clinicians and reimbursed by patients or insurance.

products.name: Behavioral Health and Therapy Services
products.description: Integrated behavioral health therapy and guided therapy visits, including trauma-based and cognitive behavioral therapy, delivered by licensed therapists as part of the clinical healthcare model. Services are provided in-person or via telemedicine and reimbursed by insurance or fee-for-service.

products.name: Healthcare Data Collection and Research Services
products.description: Collection, anonymization, and analysis of healthcare data from patient interactions, product and medication use, and experiences, with potential for research, publication, and sale to third parties, subject to privacy laws and patient consent.

products.name: Microwave and Millimeter Wave Wireless Transport Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells wireless transport systems using microwave and millimeter wave technologies for point-to-point and point-to-multipoint communications, supporting high-capacity, long-distance, and low-latency network connections. These are physical products requiring specialized manufacturing and are deployed in urban, suburban, and remote environments as alternatives to fiber and satellite.

products.name: Wireless Access Networking Solutions
products.description: Provides wireless access networking products and solutions, including ruggedized fixed and nomadic wireless access platforms for private and industrial networks, supporting applications such as smart grid, SCADA, telemetry, and vehicular connectivity. These solutions are hardware-based and often require physical installation and integration.

products.name: Routers for Wireless Transport Applications
products.description: Manufactures and sells specialized routers purpose-built for wireless transport networks, emphasizing high reliability and security for integration into microwave and millimeter wave systems. These are physical network devices integrated into broader wireless solutions.

products.name: Network Management and Operations Software
products.description: Offers premise and hosted private cloud-based software tools and applications for deployment, monitoring, management, optimization, and operational assurance of wireless networks, including automation of network design and procurement. These are digital products delivered as software or cloud services.

products.name: Professional Services for Network Planning, Deployment, and Maintenance
products.description: Provides a comprehensive suite of professional services including network planning and design, site surveys, systems integration, installation, maintenance, network monitoring, training, and customer support, covering the full lifecycle of network deployment and operation. These services are delivered by in-person human labor and technical expertise.

products.name: Third-Party Telecommunications Equipment Integration and Supply
products.description: Sources, qualifies, supplies, integrates, tests, and supports third-party telecommunications equipment such as antennas, power supplies, and optical transmission equipment as part of building and deploying complete transmission networks. This involves procurement and integration of external hardware into customer solutions.

products.name: Online E-Commerce Platform (Aviat Store)
products.description: Operates an online platform for direct sales of wireless networking products, offering online design and ordering tools, with fulfillment and supply chain support for rapid delivery. This is a digital sales channel for physical products, enhancing customer purchasing experience and logistics.

products.name: Off-Price Retail Merchandise
products.description: A broad assortment of branded, in-season apparel, footwear, accessories, home goods, beauty, toys, and gifts sold through physical retail stores at significant discounts to traditional retailers. Merchandise is sourced opportunistically and delivered via a network of company-operated stores and distribution centers.

products.name: Antibody Therapies for Neurodegenerative Diseases
products.description: Monoclonal antibody therapies selectively targeting toxic misfolded proteins (such as amyloid-beta, TDP-43, alpha-synuclein, DISC1, RACK1) implicated in neurodegenerative diseases. These are developed using a proprietary computational platform and require biologics manufacturing and clinical development.

products.name: Therapeutic Vaccines for Neurodegenerative Diseases
products.description: Vaccines designed to induce the patient's immune system to generate antibodies against toxic misfolded proteins (e.g., amyloid-beta, alpha-synuclein, TDP-43) for prophylactic or therapeutic use in diseases such as Alzheimer's, ALS, and synucleinopathies. These are produced using peptide antigens identified by the proprietary platform and require vaccine formulation and preclinical/clinical testing.

products.name: Peptide Antigens for Research and Development
products.description: Proprietary peptide antigens representing conformational epitopes of toxic misfolded proteins, used as research reagents or as the basis for generating selective antibodies, vaccines, or diagnostics. These are produced via computational modeling and peptide synthesis.

products.name: Companion Diagnostics for Neurodegenerative Diseases
products.description: Diagnostic tests (including in vitro companion diagnostics) based on proprietary peptide antigens and antibodies, designed to detect toxic misfolded proteins in neurodegenerative diseases. These require regulated diagnostic development and may be co-developed with therapeutic products.

products.name: Storage and Terminal Solutions
products.description: Engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, maintenance, and repair services for cryogenic and specialty tanks and terminals (LNG, NGLs, hydrogen, ammonia, propane, butane, liquid nitrogen/liquid oxygen, liquid petroleum), traditional aboveground crude oil and refined product storage tanks, terminal balance of plant work, truck and rail loading/offloading facilities, marine structures, and precision engineered specialty tank products. Delivered through physical manufacturing, skilled labor, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Utility and Power Infrastructure Services
products.description: Engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, and maintenance services for LNG utility peak shaving facilities, power delivery infrastructure (substations), and power generation facilities (including natural gas fired plants). Delivered via in-person skilled labor, regulated infrastructure, and project management.

products.name: Process and Industrial Facilities Services
products.description: Plant maintenance, repair, and turnaround services for downstream and midstream energy clients (refining, processing, fractionating, marketing of oil and gas), engineering, procurement, fabrication, and construction for refinery upgrades and renewable fuels, and infrastructure for industries such as chemicals, petrochemicals, sulfur, mining, minerals, cement, agriculture, and wastewater treatment. Delivered through skilled labor, engineering, and construction management.

products.name: Thermal Vacuum Test Chambers
products.description: Engineering and construction of thermal vacuum test chambers for aerospace and defense industries, requiring specialized design, fabrication, and installation expertise. Delivered through custom manufacturing and project-based construction.

products.name: Retirement Products and Services
products.description: Comprehensive retirement solutions including individual annuities (Registered Indexed Linked Annuities, traditional variable annuities), workplace retirement savings plans (403(b), 457(b), 401(k)), mutual fund-based platforms, group variable annuities, and institutional savings products. These are manufactured and administered by Equitable, requiring regulated insurance infrastructure, investment management, and distribution through advisors and third parties.

products.name: Asset Management Services
products.description: Global investment management services for institutional, retail, and private wealth clients, including actively and passively managed equities, fixed income, multi-asset solutions, hedge funds, private alternatives, and systematic strategies. Delivered by AllianceBernstein through managed accounts, mutual funds, hedge funds, and other vehicles, requiring significant financial capital, research, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Wealth Management and Financial Planning Services
products.description: Comprehensive wealth management and financial planning services for individuals and small businesses, including brokerage, discretionary and non-discretionary advisory accounts, financial planning, and distribution of proprietary and third-party insurance and annuity products. Delivered primarily through Equitable Advisors, leveraging a national advisor network and digital platforms.

products.name: Life Insurance Products
products.description: A targeted range of life insurance products for individuals and small businesses, including variable universal life (VUL), universal life (UL), indexed universal life (IUL), term life, and whole life. These products are manufactured and underwritten by Equitable, requiring regulated insurance operations and distributed primarily through Equitable Advisors.

products.name: Employee Benefits Solutions
products.description: Group insurance products and technology platform for small and medium-sized businesses, including group life (and AD&D), supplemental life, dental, vision, short-term and long-term disability, and supplemental health (accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity). Delivered through Equitable Advisors and third-party channels, requiring insurance underwriting and digital administration.

products.name: Spread Lending and Funding Agreement Products
products.description: Institutional spread-based products such as Funding Agreement Backed Notes (FABN) and collateralized borrowings, which pay a fixed rate of return to institutional investors and are supported by the company’s investment portfolio. These products require significant financial capital and risk management infrastructure.

products.name: Missile Propulsion and Energetics Systems
products.description: Vertically integrated manufacturing and supply of solid propulsion subsystems, advanced propellant formulation, and critical energetic materials for missile defense, hypersonic, and tactical munitions programs. Requires specialized manufacturing, chemical processing, and compliance with defense regulations.

products.name: Signals Intelligence and Electronic Warfare Systems
products.description: Development and delivery of end-to-end signals intelligence platforms, including spectrum monitoring, electronic warfare support, advanced geolocation, and AI-driven analytics software for government and defense customers. Delivered as integrated hardware and software solutions.

products.name: Space Communications Systems
products.description: Design and manufacture of space-qualified laser and radio frequency (RF) communications systems, including transceivers, mission-data transmitters, and command and data handling systems for LEO and deep space missions. Requires advanced hardware engineering and space certification.

products.name: Guidance, Navigation and Control Systems
products.description: Production of spacecraft guidance, navigation, and control technologies such as sun sensors, star trackers, space cameras, and inertial measurement units for satellite constellations and missile defense. Delivered as precision hardware for space and defense applications.

products.name: AI-Powered Edge Computing Platforms
products.description: Development of radiation-hardened, AI-enabled edge computing units for in-space and defense applications, integrating proprietary analytics software and partner operating systems to deliver real-time data processing at the source. Delivered as hardware-software integrated solutions.

products.name: Space Maneuver and In-Space Mobility Systems
products.description: Provision of electric and chemical propulsion systems and satellite maneuvering technologies for precision maneuvering, rendezvous, station-keeping, and collision avoidance in LEO and beyond. Requires advanced propulsion engineering and integration with spacecraft systems.

products.name: Advanced Space Technology Systems
products.description: Integrated hardware and software systems, including in-space propulsion and engineering services, for NASA, DoD, and commercial customers. Supports orbital servicing, manufacturing, and deep space exploration. Delivered as mission-specific technology packages and services.

products.name: Space Infrastructure Modules (e.g., Bishop Airlock)
products.description: Design, manufacture, and operation of space infrastructure modules such as the Bishop Airlock, enabling movement of equipment and payloads between the ISS and open space. Delivered as physical modules installed on space stations, requiring advanced engineering and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Space Science and Mission Management Services
products.description: Provision of mission management, payload deployment, and scientific experiment services for commercial, academic, and government customers on the ISS and other platforms. Delivered as managed services leveraging in-orbit infrastructure and expertise.

products.name: Commercial Space Station (Starlab)
products.description: Design, manufacture, and operation of Starlab, a commercial space station intended to replace the ISS, providing infrastructure for permanent human presence, research, manufacturing, and commercial activities in LEO. Delivered as a large-scale, long-term orbital platform.

products.name: VK2735 (GLP-1/GIP Dual Agonist Therapies
products.description: A novel dual agonist of the GLP-1 and GIP receptors, developed in both subcutaneous injectable and oral tablet formulations for the treatment of metabolic disorders such as obesity and type 2 diabetes. These are manufactured via pharmaceutical processes and delivered as either weekly injections or daily oral tablets.

products.name: Dual Amylin and Calcitonin Receptor Agonist (DACRA) Therapies
products.description: Preclinical-stage dual amylin and calcitonin receptor agonists for the potential treatment of obesity, delivered as subcutaneous injections. These are developed through pharmaceutical R&D and require regulated manufacturing.

products.name: VK2809 (Selective TRß Agonist Therapies for Metabolic and Liver Disorders)
products.description: An orally available, tissue- and receptor-subtype selective agonist of the thyroid hormone receptor beta (TRß), developed for the treatment of non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH/MASH), non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), and lipid disorders. Delivered as a once-daily oral tablet, manufactured via pharmaceutical processes.

products.name: VK0214 (Selective TRß Agonist Therapies for X-Linked Adrenoleukodystrophy)
products.description: An orally available, tissue- and receptor-subtype selective agonist of TRß, developed for the treatment of X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy (X-ALD), a rare neurological disorder. Delivered as a once-daily oral tablet, produced through pharmaceutical manufacturing.

products.name: VK5211 (Selective Androgen Receptor Modulator for Muscle Wasting)
products.description: An orally available, non-steroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM) developed for the treatment of muscle wasting and recovery following hip fracture surgery. Delivered as a once-daily oral tablet, manufactured via pharmaceutical processes.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by non-residential and multi-family commercial properties, including office buildings, retail, industrial, mixed-use, hotel/motel, and other income-producing real estate. Loans are physically originated and serviced through in-person and digital channels, requiring regulated underwriting and collateral management.

products.name: Commercial Construction and Land Development Lending
products.description: Origination of loans to finance the construction and development of commercial properties and multi-family projects, including rehabilitation loans. These are physically originated, monitored, and disbursed as construction progresses, requiring regulated oversight and collateral management.

products.name: Commercial Business Lending
products.description: Origination of loans and lines of credit to small- and medium-sized businesses, including term loans, revolving lines, and participations in leveraged lending transactions. Delivered through in-person and digital channels, requiring financial capital, regulated underwriting, and collateral management.

products.name: Indirect Automobile Lending
products.description: Provision of indirect financing for automobile purchases through partnerships with local automobile dealerships. Loans are originated via dealer referrals, require regulated underwriting, and are secured by vehicles.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Purchase and servicing of one- to four-family residential mortgage loans, primarily owner-occupied, through a correspondent relationship with a third-party non-bank mortgage lender. Loans are physically secured by real estate and require regulated underwriting and servicing.

products.name: Home Equity Lending
products.description: Origination of home equity loans and lines of credit secured by one- to four-family primary or secondary residences. Delivered through in-person and digital channels, requiring regulated underwriting and collateral management.

products.name: Deposit Accounts and Related Services
products.description: Provision of a variety of deposit accounts, including savings, certificates of deposit, money market, checking, and individual retirement accounts, delivered through physical branches and digital channels (ATMs, online, mobile, ACH, remote deposit capture, telephone banking). Requires regulated infrastructure and customer service.

products.name: Investment and Financial Advisory Services
products.description: Provision of investment advisory, brokerage, retirement planning, and insurance product sales to individuals and businesses through Rhinebeck Asset Management. Services are delivered via licensed advisors and digital platforms, requiring regulatory compliance and partnerships with third-party broker-dealers.

products.name: Residential Homesites and Communities
products.description: Development and sale of residential homesites and master-planned communities, primarily to homebuilders and, on a limited basis, to retail customers. This involves land development, entitlement, and infrastructure construction.

products.name: Hospitality Services and Properties
products.description: Ownership, joint ownership, and operation of hotels (luxury boutique and branded), vacation rentals, marinas, food and beverage outlets, retail outlets, and entertainment offerings, as well as exclusive membership clubs with amenities such as golf courses and beach clubs. These services require physical property management, hospitality staff, and regulated operations.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Leasing and Development
products.description: Development, ownership, joint ownership, and leasing of commercial properties for uses including multi-family, senior living, self-storage, mixed-use, medical, office, retail, and industrial. This involves property development, leasing, and ongoing property management.

products.name: Land Sales (Developed and Undeveloped)
products.description: Sale of developed and undeveloped land parcels for residential, commercial, or other uses. This includes both improved and unimproved land, requiring entitlement and sometimes infrastructure development.

products.name: Timber and Forestry Products
products.description: Management of timber holdings and sale of forestry products such as pulpwood and sawtimber. This involves sustainable forest management, harvesting, and compliance with environmental regulations.

products.name: Real Estate Brokerage Services
products.description: Provision of real estate brokerage services to external customers, facilitating the buying and selling of properties. This is a service-based business requiring licensed professionals.

products.name: Title Insurance and Insurance Agency Services
products.description: Provision of title insurance and other insurance agency services related to real estate transactions. This involves regulated insurance operations and customer service.

products.name: Mitigation Banking and Environmental Credits
products.description: Operation of mitigation banks that produce mitigation credits for developers to offset environmental impacts, requiring regulatory approval and environmental management.

products.name: Sonos Speakers
products.description: A range of wireless speakers including all-in-one, portable, and home theater speakers, as well as headphones, designed and manufactured by Sonos and delivered as physical consumer electronics for home and portable use.

products.name: Sonos System Products (Audio Components)
products.description: Audio components such as amplifiers and streaming devices that allow customers to integrate third-party wired systems and traditional audio setups into the Sonos wireless platform, delivered as physical hardware products.

products.name: Partner Products and Accessories
products.description: Accessories and partner-branded products including stands, mounts, shelving units, architectural speakers (in-ceiling, in-wall, outdoor), and automotive sound systems, delivered as physical products through partnerships and collaborations.

products.name: Sonos Software Platform
products.description: A proprietary software platform including the Sonos App, device firmware, and cloud orchestration layer, enabling multi-room audio, integration with content partners, and ongoing feature updates, delivered digitally to Sonos device owners.

products.name: Subscription-Based Services and Licensing
products.description: Subscription services, licensing agreements, and advertising revenue related to the Sonos platform, providing digital services and access to content or technology for customers and partners.

products.name: Fasteners and Anchors
products.description: Manufactured and distributed nuts, bolts, screws, washers, specialty fasteners, construction fasteners, and anchors for retail and industrial customers. Products are sourced globally, require physical manufacturing, and are delivered through a large distribution network.

products.name: Builder's Hardware
products.description: A range of household and construction hardware items such as coat hooks, door stops, hinges, gate latches, and decorative hardware, manufactured and distributed to retailers with merchandising support. Products are physically produced and require in-store and online merchandising.

products.name: Threaded Rod and Metal Shapes
products.description: Hot and cold rolled threaded rods, all-thread rods, and metal shapes in various materials, manufactured and distributed to retailers and wholesalers. Requires physical manufacturing and logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Rope, Chain, and Related Hardware
products.description: Manufactured and distributed rope, twine, chain, wire rope, and related hardware products for retail and industrial use. Products are physically produced and distributed through retail and wholesale channels.

products.name: Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and Work Gear
products.description: Manufactured and distributed work gloves, safety products (face masks, vests), tool storage, knee pads, and related work gear for DIY and professional users. Products are physically produced and distributed to retailers under multiple brands.

products.name: Cleaning Products and Textiles
products.description: Wiping cloths, consumable rags, and cleaning textiles for painting, janitorial, maintenance, and auto/marine care, manufactured and distributed to retailers and industrial customers. Products require physical manufacturing and logistics.

products.name: Letters, Numbers, and Signs (LNS)
products.description: Manufactured and distributed individual and packaged letters, numbers, signs, safety signs, driveway markers, and sign accessories for home and commercial use. Products are physically produced and distributed to retail outlets.

products.name: Key Duplication Systems and Keys
products.description: Robotic and store associate-assisted key duplication systems, proprietary key blanks, and key fobs, designed, manufactured, and supported for retail deployment. Includes both self-service kiosks and assisted systems, with ongoing support and software integration.

products.name: Engraving Kiosks and Identification Tags
products.description: Robotic self-service engraving kiosks and a variety of blank tags (pet, luggage, identification), designed, manufactured, and deployed in retail locations. Includes proprietary software and hardware, with ongoing support and merchandising.

products.name: Merchandising and In-Store Inventory Services
products.description: Design, installation, and maintenance of merchandising systems, inventory management, and break-fix services for robotic kiosks, provided to retail customers to support product sales and optimize in-store operations. Delivered through a large field service organization.

products.name: Advanced Sensing Systems
products.description: Designs, develops, and manufactures advanced sensing technologies including electro-optic/infrared (EO/IR), signals intelligence (SIGINT), electronic warfare (EW), tactical radars, and surveillance sensors. These are physically manufactured systems integrated onto land, air, sea, space, and cyber platforms for real-time detection, targeting, and situational awareness.

products.name: Network Edge Computing Solutions
products.description: Develops and manufactures rugged, cyber-resilient network edge computing products for data processing, fusion, and dissemination at the tactical edge. These systems are physically manufactured and support platform computing, battle management, command and control, and tactical communications, leveraging AI and open architecture software.

products.name: Integrated Electronic Warfare Systems
products.description: Designs, develops, and integrates electronic warfare systems that combine sensing, computing, and software to detect, process, and act on threats in real time. These are complex, physically manufactured and software-enabled systems for distributed operations and resilient communications.

products.name: Naval Electric Power and Propulsion Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and integrates power conversion, control, distribution, and propulsion systems for naval vessels, including permanent magnet motors, energy storage, and advanced thermal management. These are large-scale, physically manufactured systems installed on submarines, aircraft carriers, and surface ships.

products.name: Force Protection and Survivability Systems
products.description: Develops and integrates force protection systems for ground vehicles and personnel, including short-range air defense, counter-unmanned aircraft systems (C-UAS), vehicle survivability, and protection solutions. These are integrated systems combining radars, EW equipment, sensors, and kinetic countermeasures, physically manufactured and installed on defense platforms.

products.name: Platform Computing and Tactical Communications
products.description: Provides platform computing and tactical communications systems for ground and shipboard applications, supporting battle management, combat systems, radar, command and control, and tactical networks. These are rugged, physically manufactured computing and communications products integrated into defense platforms.

products.name: Transportation and Logistics Systems for Defense
products.description: Designs, develops, and integrates transportation and logistics systems for military applications, supporting the movement and sustainment of defense assets. These are physically manufactured and integrated systems tailored for defense customers.

products.name: Digital Evidence Management Software
products.description: Cloud-based SaaS platform enabling secure storage, management, sharing, and analysis of video and digital evidence, primarily delivered via subscription licensing and integrated with Axon hardware.

products.name: Productivity and Records Management Software
products.description: Suite of cloud-based and on-premise software solutions for report writing, records management, standards compliance, and workflow automation, delivered as SaaS and supporting public safety agency operations.

products.name: Real-Time Operations and Situational Awareness Software
products.description: Software solutions providing real-time location data, alerts, and video feeds to support operational awareness and incident response, including platforms like Axon Respond and Axon Fusus, delivered as SaaS.

products.name: Emergency Communications and 911 Software
products.description: Cloud-based and integrated software platforms for emergency call handling, AI-powered triage, multimedia streaming, and NG911 workflows, serving public safety answering points and emergency communications centers.

products.name: Professional Services for Software Implementation
products.description: Non-recurring professional services supporting implementation, configuration, and workflow integration of Axon software solutions, delivered by specialized teams to ensure customer success.

products.name: TASER Conducted Energy Devices and Accessories
products.description: Manufactured less-lethal conducted energy devices (CEDs) for law enforcement and personal safety, sold under the TASER brand, including devices, cartridges, accessories, and extended warranties.

products.name: Body-Worn and Personal Cameras and Sensors
products.description: Manufactured body-worn cameras and personal sensors, including Axon Body cameras and accessories, designed for evidence capture, transparency, and integration with Axon software workflows.

products.name: In-Car, Fixed, and Surveillance Camera Systems
products.description: Manufactured in-car video systems, fixed cameras, and surveillance solutions (e.g., Axon Fleet, Axon Outpost, Axon Lightpost) for operational awareness and evidence capture, integrated with software platforms.

products.name: Drone and Counter-Drone Systems
products.description: Manufactured drones, counter-drone hardware, and integrated drone management software platforms (e.g., Axon Air, Sky-Hero, Dedrone) for situational awareness, surveillance, and threat mitigation.

products.name: Virtual Reality Training Systems
products.description: Manufactured virtual reality (VR) hardware and software platforms for immersive de-escalation and scenario-based training for law enforcement, corrections, and private security.

products.name: Automotive Maintenance Services
products.description: Regularly scheduled and as-needed automotive maintenance services, including oil changes, brake, heating and cooling systems, exhaust, and tire services, delivered through franchised and company-operated locations using in-person labor and specialized equipment.

products.name: Collision Repair Services
products.description: Full collision repair and refinishing services for vehicles, including cosmetic repairs, provided primarily through a large franchised network using physical repair facilities and skilled technicians.

products.name: Automotive Paint and Cosmetic Repair Services
products.description: Automotive body repainting, touch-up, surface preparation, protection, refinishing, and other cosmetic external and internal repairs, delivered through franchised locations with physical facilities and specialized equipment.

products.name: Automotive Glass Repair, Replacement, and Calibration Services
products.description: Repair, replacement, and calibration of automotive glass for retail, commercial, and insurance customers, provided through franchised and company-operated locations using specialized tools and trained technicians.

products.name: Car Wash Services
products.description: Express-style exterior car wash services using automated conveyor belt systems, delivered through company-operated and independently-operated locations, with a focus on speed, affordability, and convenience.

products.name: Automotive Parts Distribution
products.description: Distribution of a broad mix of automotive parts, including radiators, air conditioning components, exhaust products, and consumables, to repair shops and other outlets, using a franchised and company-operated logistics network.

products.name: Automotive Training Services
products.description: Financial and operational training services for independent repair, maintenance, paint, and collision shops, delivered through multi-year subscription packages and in-person or digital instruction.

products.name: Glass Claims Management Services
products.description: Technology-enabled glass claims management services for insurance carriers, facilitating claims processing and driving business to glass service locations and distribution operations.

products.name: Automotive E-commerce Platform
products.description: Online platform providing procurement and purchasing services for automotive supplies and parts to franchisees and network members, leveraging supplier relationships and digital ordering systems.

products.name: Women's Intimate Apparel
products.description: Includes bras, panties, lingerie, and related intimate wear, designed and developed in-house and produced through an internationally outsourced manufacturing platform. Sold through company-operated stores, digital channels, and international partners.

products.name: Women's Sleepwear, Loungewear, and Apparel
products.description: Comprises sleepwear, loungewear, and casual apparel for women, designed internally and manufactured via global sourcing partners. Distributed through physical stores, digital platforms, and international franchise and wholesale arrangements.

products.name: Sport and Swimwear
products.description: Includes sport bras, activewear, and swimwear for women, designed and sourced globally, and sold through stores and digital channels under Victoria’s Secret and PINK brands.

products.name: Prestige Fragrances and Body Care
products.description: A line of branded fragrances, body lotions, and related beauty products, primarily manufactured in Ohio and distributed through stores, digital channels, and international partners.

products.name: Women's Accessories
products.description: Includes fashion accessories such as bags and related items, offered primarily under the PINK brand and through subscription styling services. Products are sourced globally and sold via stores and digital channels.

products.name: Subscription Styling Service for Women's Apparel and Accessories
products.description: A digital subscription service (DailyLook) providing curated women's apparel and accessories, delivered directly to customers through an online platform.

products.name: Contact Lenses
products.description: Manufactured soft and rigid gas permeable contact lenses, including daily disposable, planned replacement, multifocal, toric, and specialty lenses, delivered through direct sales and distributors globally.

products.name: Consumer Eye Care Products
products.description: Manufactured and distributed over-the-counter eye drops, eye moisturizers, redness relievers, and eye vitamin and mineral supplements, sold through retailers and pharmacies.

products.name: Contact Lens Care Solutions
products.description: Manufactured multi-purpose and specialty solutions for cleaning, disinfecting, and storing contact lenses, distributed through retail and professional channels.

products.name: Ophthalmic Pharmaceuticals
products.description: Manufactured and marketed proprietary and generic prescription eye medications for conditions such as dry eye disease, glaucoma, ocular inflammation, and retinal diseases, delivered via pharmacies, hospitals, and eye care professionals.

products.name: Ophthalmic Surgical Equipment and Devices
products.description: Manufactured and supplied medical device equipment, including phacoemulsification systems, femtosecond and excimer lasers, and other surgical instruments for cataract, corneal, vitreous, and retinal eye surgeries, sold to hospitals and surgical centers.

products.name: Intraocular Lenses (IOLs) and Delivery Systems
products.description: Manufactured and distributed implantable intraocular lenses and associated delivery systems for use in cataract and refractive surgeries, sold to ophthalmic surgeons and surgical centers.

products.name: Ophthalmic Surgical Consumables and Instruments
products.description: Produced and supplied single-use and reusable surgical consumables and precision instruments, including microsurgical tools and diamond knives, for ophthalmic procedures, distributed to surgical centers and professionals.

products.name: Crude Oil Production and Sales
products.description: Exploration, development, production, and sale of crude oil, primarily from operated wells in the Williston Basin, delivered to refiners, marketers, and other purchasers via gathering systems and pipelines. This involves significant physical extraction, regulated infrastructure, and in-house marketing operations.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Production and Sales
products.description: Production and sale of natural gas liquids (NGLs) extracted alongside crude oil and natural gas, marketed to external customers through gathering systems and pipelines. This requires physical extraction, processing, and regulated transportation infrastructure.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Production and sale of natural gas from operated and non-operated wells, primarily in the Williston Basin and with limited interests in the Marcellus Shale, delivered to customers via gathering systems and pipelines. This involves physical extraction, processing, and regulated transportation.

products.name: REIT Investment Services
products.description: The company operates as a real estate investment trust (REIT), investing in and managing a portfolio of real estate-related assets, primarily through financial capital and portfolio management expertise. Revenue is generated from investment returns and distributions to shareholders.

products.name: Clinical Laboratory Diagnostic Systems
products.description: Instruments and assays for clinical chemistry and immunoassay testing in centralized and decentralized laboratories, including VITROS platforms, manufactured using advanced dry slide and chemiluminescent technologies, and delivered as integrated systems with broad test menus for disease detection and health management.

products.name: Molecular Diagnostic Testing Systems
products.description: Molecular diagnostic platforms and assays, including PCR and isothermal amplification systems, for rapid detection and identification of infectious diseases, delivered as sample-to-result instruments and ready-to-use reagent kits for laboratories and healthcare providers.

products.name: Point-of-Care Diagnostic Testing
products.description: Rapid diagnostic instruments and tests, including immunoassays and visually read tests, designed for use in decentralized healthcare settings and at home, providing quick results for infectious diseases, cardiac markers, drugs of abuse, and other conditions, delivered via portable analyzers and lateral flow devices.

products.name: Transfusion Medicine Diagnostic Systems
products.description: Automated and semi-automated immunohematology instruments and assays for blood typing, antibody identification, and donor screening, supporting blood banks and donor centers with solutions for patient-donor compatibility and infectious disease screening.

products.name: Virology and Specialty Bioassays
products.description: Cell-based products, specimen collection devices, and specialty assays for virology research and diagnosis, including bioassays for autoimmune diseases and biomarkers for bone health, produced using cell culture and immunoassay technologies for laboratory and research use.

products.name: Contract Manufacturing Services
products.description: Manufacturing services for third-party diagnostic products, leveraging the company’s global production facilities and regulatory expertise to produce and package diagnostic assays and components for external partners.

products.name: Diagnostic Informatics and Data Management Solutions
products.description: Software platforms and digital solutions for laboratory workflow automation, results management, remote monitoring, and data analytics, delivered as cloud-based or on-premise tools to enhance operational efficiency and connectivity of diagnostic instruments.

products.name: Roxadustat
products.description: An orally administered small molecule drug developed and manufactured using commercial chemical technologies, used for the treatment of anemia in chronic kidney disease (CKD) and in anemia associated with lower-risk myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS). Roxadustat is produced via third-party contract manufacturing and supplied globally, with commercial rights in various territories managed through partnerships.

products.name: FG-3246 Antibody-Drug Conjugate (ADC)
products.description: A novel antibody-drug conjugate targeting CD46, developed for the treatment of metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) and potentially other cancers. FG-3246 is manufactured using biotechnological processes and is delivered via infusion in clinical settings.

products.name: FG-3180 PET Imaging Agent
products.description: A CD46-targeted positron emission tomography (PET) biomarker and imaging agent, developed as a companion diagnostic to identify and select patients for FG-3246 therapy in mCRPC. FG-3180 is produced using radiolabeling of the CD46-targeted antibody and delivered as a diagnostic radiopharmaceutical in clinical settings.

products.name: Insurance Carrier Services
products.description: Provision of insurance coverage including property-casualty, life, health, and reinsurance, typically requiring regulated financial capital, underwriting, and claims management infrastructure.

products.name: Insurance Distribution Services
products.description: Distribution of insurance products through retail agents, insurance brokers, or managing general underwriters, involving human salesforce and regulated intermediary operations.

products.name: Insurance-Related Service Provider Solutions
products.description: Services supporting insurance operations such as claims management, medical cost management, data and technology provision, and asset management, delivered via specialized human labor and digital platforms.

products.name: InsurTech Solutions
products.description: Technology-driven insurance solutions focused on maximizing savings and efficiency, launching growth opportunities, and innovating risk selection processes, delivered primarily through digital platforms and software.

products.name: Oxylanthanum Carbonate (OLC)
products.description: An orally administered, next-generation, non-calcium-based phosphate binder developed using proprietary nanoparticle technology for the treatment of hyperphosphatemia in chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients on dialysis. Manufactured via contract manufacturing organizations and delivered as a swallowable tablet to reduce pill burden and improve patient adherence.

products.name: UNI-494
products.description: A novel, proprietary prodrug of nicorandil designed for the treatment of acute kidney injury (AKI) and delayed graft function (DGF) in kidney transplant patients. Developed through in-licensing, UNI-494 is administered systemically to release nicorandil and is intended to minimize gastrointestinal side effects. Currently in clinical development, with manufacturing outsourced to third parties.

products.name: ARCALYST
products.description: A biologic therapy (IL-1α and IL-1β cytokine trap) manufactured as a recombinant fusion protein, administered via weekly subcutaneous injection, and distributed through specialty pharmacies for the treatment of recurrent pericarditis, CAPS (including FCAS and Muckle-Wells Syndrome), and DIRA. Commercially available in the US and licensed for development and commercialization in parts of Asia.

products.name: KPL-387 (Investigational Therapy)
products.description: A fully human monoclonal antibody (IgG2) targeting IL-1R1, designed for monthly subcutaneous self-administration in liquid formulation, currently in Phase 2/3 clinical trials for recurrent pericarditis. Not yet approved or marketed.

products.name: KPL-1161 (Preclinical Therapy)
products.description: A preclinical, Fc-modified monoclonal antibody targeting IL-1R1, designed for quarterly subcutaneous dosing, intended to treat diseases mediated by IL-1α and IL-1β. Not yet in human trials or marketed.

products.name: Abiprubart (Investigational Therapy)
products.description: An investigational monoclonal antibody inhibitor of CD40-CD154 costimulatory interaction, previously in Phase 2b trials for Sjögren’s Disease and other autoimmune diseases, with development discontinued and strategic alternatives being explored. Not marketed.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution Services
products.description: Provision of regulated natural gas delivery, including purchasing, distributing, and transporting natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in Arizona, Nevada, and California. This service requires significant physical infrastructure, regulatory compliance, and ongoing investment in pipeline and storage facilities.

products.name: Natural Gas Transportation Services for Customer-Secured Gas
products.description: Transportation of customer-procured natural gas to end-users, primarily large commercial, industrial, and electric generation customers, utilizing Southwest Gas's pipeline infrastructure. This service is regulated and involves negotiated contracts and tariff programs.

products.name: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Supply and Delivery
products.description: Procurement and delivery of renewable natural gas (RNG) to customers, including compliance with state mandates and participation in RNG projects. This involves sourcing RNG from waste and integrating it into the existing gas supply portfolio, requiring regulatory approval and infrastructure adaptation.

products.name: Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) Fueling Services
products.description: Provision of compressed natural gas (CNG) as a transportation fuel to external customers, including companies operating vehicle fleets in Arizona and Nevada. This service requires specialized fueling infrastructure and supports alternative fuel initiatives.

products.name: Industrial and Commercial Staffing Services
products.description: Provision of temporary, permanent, and temp-to-perm staffing solutions for industrial, manufacturing, logistics, food production, administrative, accounting, finance, hospitality, legal, and medical sectors. Services are delivered through a national network of offices and onsite operations, involving recruitment, placement, payroll administration, and workforce management.

products.name: IT and Technology Staffing and Consulting Services
products.description: Specialized staffing, recruitment, and consulting services for technology professionals, including software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, project management, and emerging technologies. Services include temporary and contract staffing, permanent placement, and consulting enablement, primarily delivered in Europe through Circle8's portfolio of brands.

products.name: Managed Service Provider (MSP) and Vendor Management Services
products.description: Comprehensive management of workforce programs for clients, including vendor management, program management, and administration of large-scale staffing needs. Services leverage advanced technology and operational expertise to deliver predictable costs and scalable solutions.

products.name: Payroll and Employment Administration Services
products.description: Provision of payroll administration, tax withholding, statutory contributions, and compliance services for professionals placed with clients, including payrolling services where the company acts as the legal employer for client-identified professionals.

products.name: Refrigerants and Thermal Management Solutions
products.description: Chemours manufactures and sells refrigerants, thermal management solutions, propellants, foam blowing agents, and specialty solvents, primarily based on fluorochemical technology. These products are produced at large-scale chemical manufacturing facilities and delivered globally for use in air conditioning, refrigeration, and industrial applications.

products.name: Titanium Dioxide (TiO2) Pigment
products.description: Chemours produces and sells high-quality titanium dioxide pigment under the Ti-Pure™ brand, using proprietary chloride technology at large manufacturing plants. TiO2 pigment is a key input for whiteness, brightness, and opacity in coatings, plastics, laminates, and paper products.

products.name: Specialty Minerals (Zircon, Staurolite, Monazite)
products.description: Chemours mines and sells specialty minerals such as zircon, staurolite, and monazite, which are co-products of its mineral sands mining operations in Florida and Georgia. These minerals are processed and supplied for use in investment casting, abrasives, ceramics, and as rare earth sources for clean energy applications.

products.name: Advanced Fluoropolymer and Specialty Polymer Products
products.description: Chemours manufactures and sells advanced fluoropolymers and specialty polymers, including Teflon™, Viton™, Krytox™, and Nafion™ products. These are produced at chemical manufacturing facilities and delivered globally for use in electronics, semiconductors, automotive, energy, chemical processing, and medical applications, offering properties such as chemical inertness, thermal stability, and electrical insulation.

products.name: Osteoarthritis (OA) Pain Management Products
products.description: HA-based viscosupplementation products (Orthovisc, Monovisc, Cingal) for pain relief in osteoarthritis, primarily administered via injection in office settings. Manufactured at the company's facility and distributed through partners and direct sales channels.

products.name: Regenerative Solutions
products.description: HA-based implantable scaffolds and injectable bone substitutes (Integrity, Hyalofast, Tactoset) for tendon repair, cartilage regeneration, and bone repair, delivered via surgical procedures in hospitals and ambulatory surgery centers. Products are manufactured in-house and sold directly or through distributors.

products.name: Non-Orthopedic HA-Based Products
products.description: Legacy HA-based products for non-orthopedic applications, including veterinary joint injections (Hyvisc), anti-adhesion barriers for surgery (Hyalobarrier), and ophthalmic viscoelastic agents (Anikavisc, Nuvisc) used in cataract and intraocular lens procedures. These are manufactured by the company and sold globally through commercial partners.

products.name: Therapeutic Cancer Vaccines (T-win Platform)
products.description: Immune-modulatory, off-the-shelf therapeutic cancer vaccines developed using the T-win platform, designed to activate and expand T cells against immunosuppressive targets in the tumor microenvironment. These vaccines are manufactured via synthetic peptide chemistry and delivered by subcutaneous injection, often in combination with checkpoint inhibitors.

products.name: Cylembio (IO102-IO103) Cancer Vaccine
products.description: Lead therapeutic cancer vaccine candidate combining IO102 and IO103 peptides, targeting IDO and PD-L1 expressing cells in the tumor microenvironment. Manufactured as a lyophilized peptide powder, reconstituted and administered subcutaneously, typically in combination with anti-PD-1 therapy for advanced melanoma and other solid tumors.

products.name: IO112 (Arginase 1) Cancer Vaccine
products.description: Investigational peptide-based cancer vaccine targeting Arginase 1, designed to activate Arginase 1-specific T cells for use in solid tumors with high myeloid-derived suppressor cell content. Manufactured as a synthetic peptide and delivered by subcutaneous injection; currently in preclinical and early clinical development.

products.name: TGFβ1 (IO170) Cancer Vaccine
products.description: Preclinical-stage peptide vaccine targeting TGFβ1-expressing cells in the tumor microenvironment, aiming to modulate immunosuppression and drive anti-tumor immune responses. Manufactured via synthetic peptide chemistry and intended for subcutaneous administration.

products.name: Wholesale Motor Fuel Distribution
products.description: Distribution of branded and unbranded motor fuels to independent dealers and lessee dealers under exclusive supply contracts, involving physical transportation and regulated supply agreements.

products.name: Retail Sale of Motor Fuel
products.description: Retail sale of branded and unbranded motor fuels to end customers at company operated and commission agent sites, requiring physical site operations and inventory management.

products.name: Retail Sale of Convenience Merchandise
products.description: Sale of convenience merchandise, including food and other goods, to end customers at company operated retail sites, involving physical inventory and in-person transactions.

products.name: Real Estate Leasing and Subleasing
products.description: Leasing or subleasing of owned or leased real estate and personal property to wholesale customers and commission agents, generating rental income through property management.
